concepts.gloss_en: The Temple itself (the edifice/place), identified with da'at and kodesh
The building/construction of the Temple (the act), = renewal of the mochin/soul — not the Temple itself

members.note: action/state, construct head בנין; per rule 4 not identical to בית המקדש

concepts.gloss_en: The burning/destruction of the Temple (the act) — distinct action, opposite valence

members.note: action of burning; construct head שרפה; not the Temple itself

concepts.gloss_en: The labor/work of building the Temple — construct head מלאכה (labor), distinct from the abstract 'building' and from the Temple itself

members.note: distinct construct head מלאכה (work/labor); kept separate per rule 4 and under-merge preference

notes: Four distinct concepts: the Temple (object) vs. three different construct-head expressions naming actions/states about it (building, burning, labor-of-building). No orthographic variants to merge. מלאכת בנין and בנין could arguably be seen as one process, but they have different construct heads and under-merge is preferred.
